item.title: D-Wave Awarded NRC Funding to Advance Commercial Annealing Algorithms and Software
item.summary: Quantum computing provider D-Wave Quantum Inc. (NASDAQ: QBTS) has been awarded up to CAD $300,000 ($299,025) in funding from the National Research Council of Canada’s (NRC) Applied Quantum Computing Challenge program. Conducted at D-Wave’s Quantum Centre of Engineering Excellence in Burnaby, British Columbia, the joint project aims to develop next-generation graph-embedding algorithms and open-source software [...] The post D-Wave Awarded NRC Funding to Advance Commercial Annealing Algorithms and Software appeared first on Quantum Computing Report .
